item.title: 【Requests】[REQ VID] - Post Malone F-1 Trillion Livestream
item.description:
Hi,

in 2024, Post Malone did a YouTube live stream to play some songs from his album F-1 Trillion along with some classic songs in new variations. The original stream is nowhere to be found on the Internet but cut versions of individual songs are uploaded on his official YouTube channel.

Anyone who captured the original live stream back in 2024 and mind sharing it?

Best regards!
item.author: SleepyM
